# TrustyToggleGroup

`Form/Controls` · composition depth: `base`

A row of toggle buttons acting as one control. 'single' keeps at most one pressed (radio-like, string v-model) and, once one is picked, re-clicking it keeps it pressed; 'multiple' allows any number (string-array v-model). Items take labels, icons, and per-item disabling.

**Use it when**
- a few mutually exclusive modes sit side by side in a toolbar: alignment, view mode, units ('single').
- a small set of independent filters reads as one control ('multiple').

**Don't use it for**
- a labelled choice in a form: use TrustyRadioGroup, or TrustySelect for longer lists
- one independent on/off button: use TrustyToggle
- swapping what a region shows: use TrustyTabs

```ts
import { TrustyToggleGroup } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `{ value: string; label?: string \| undefined; icon?: `${string}:${string}` \| undefined; disabled?: boolean \| undefined; }[]` | *required* | The options, in order. Each item: - `value`: unique value v-model reports when the item is on - `label`: text (omit for icon-only — then `value` is its a11y name) - `icon`: icon name (Iconify `collection:icon`, e.g. `ph:gear`) - `disabled`: disable just this item |
| `type` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | `"single"` | `single` = one on once picked (radio-like — re-clicking it keeps it on); `multiple` = any number on. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole group. |
| `modelValue` | `string \| string[]` | — |  |

## Events

- `update:modelValue` — `[value: string \| string[] \| undefined]`

## Examples in Storybook

- Single — Single select (radio-like) — at most one item on; re-clicking the pressed one keeps it on.
- Multiple — Multiple select — `v-model` is an array; any number can be on.
- Icons — Icon-only items — `value` becomes each item's accessible name.
- Disabled
